description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose screen for creating a new connection profile in an Android app. It includes UI components such as text fields for profile details, password visibility toggle, and a save button that persists data via ProfileRepository.

methods.name: NewProfileScreen
methods.description: Composable function that renders the UI for creating a new profile, managing input states, and handling the save action.
